observations: Photo 0 shows a black plastic waste bin with a lid, standing next to a blue bin and large white IBC totes in the background.
The black bin has 'STOREX' embossed on the front and also printed in white lettering below the embossed logo.
The lid has a textured, cracked surface, possibly from weathering or damage.
Photo 1 is a closer view of the same black bin, showing the embossed 'STOREX' logo with two rhino silhouettes on either side.
The bin appears to be made of thick plastic, with visible wear and scuff marks.
No wheels or mobility features are visible in either photo.
The seller's text mentions 'Heavy-Duty Mobile Waste Bin', but no wheels are shown in the photos.

response.reason: The brand is confirmed as STOREX, but the claim of being 'mobile' cannot be verified without seeing the base. The lid shows visible damage, and structural integrity is unknown. These factors affect pricing and must be proven before a final valuation.
